description: Use this when a template lacks a field or clause the user needs, no template fits the request, a tool result was wrong, or the user wants to tell the ClauseAI team something. The message goes to the ClauseAI operator. Do not include document text or personal details.

email.description: Optional address for a reply. Only pass one the user gave you.

message.description:
What you were trying to do and what was wrong or missing.
Up to 4000 characters.

slug.description: Template slug the feedback is about, if any.

name: send_feedback

outputSchema.description: Confirmation that feedback reached the ClauseAI operator.

title: Send feedback
